title: helicostylis tomentosa
intro: Helicostylis tomentosa, commonly known as the "Tomentosa", is a plant species within the family Moraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues.
